items.title: 4TB of voice samples just stolen from 40k AI contractors at Mercor
items.title_zh: Mercor 4 万名 AI 承包商的 4TB 语音样本被盗
items.summary: Lapsus$ posted Mercor on its leak site, and the stolen material reportedly bundles voice biometrics with ID documents, which the post describes as a deepfake-ready kit.

items.title: The woes of sanitizing SVGs
items.title_zh: 清理 SVG 的烦恼
items.summary: Scratch has a long history of SVG vulnerabilities because it parses attacker-controlled SVG into an element and appends it to the main document for operations such as measuring bounding boxes; the post describes its increasingly complex sanitisation infrastructure as an attempt to make that inherently unsafe step safe.

items.title: OpenAI CEO's Identity Verification Company Announced Fake Bruno Mars Partnership
items.title_zh: OpenAI CEO 旗下身份验证公司宣布与 Bruno Mars 合作，歌手本人并不知情
items.summary: Tools For Humanity, the identity verification company linked to OpenAI's CEO, announced a Bruno Mars tour partnership that the artist had not been told about.

items.title_zh: Cursor Camp

items.summary: Mozilla's standards-positions issue records its opposition to Chrome's proposed Prompt API, linking to the Prompt API explainer.

items.title: Show HN: AI CAD Harness
items.title_zh: Show HN：AI CAD Harness
items.summary: Show HN: Adam's AI CAD harness, which plugs into Autodesk Fusion and PTC Onshape, reads a part's existing feature tree and edits it agentically rather than emitting a black-box STL. The launch post drew 101 points and 96 comments.

items.title: Six years perfecting maps on watchOS
items.title_zh: 六年打磨 watchOS 上的地图
items.summary: Developer blog post at david-smith.org recounting six years spent perfecting the maps experience in watchOS apps, shared on Hacker News where it drew 457 points and 120 comments.

items.title: Agentic Coding Is a Trap
items.title_zh: 智能体编程是个陷阱
items.summary: Front-page Hacker News essay (463 points, 375 comments) arguing that agentic coding is a trap and urging developers to stay vigilant about cognitive debt and skill atrophy.

items.title: New statue in London, attributed to Banksy, of a suited man, blinded by a flag
items.title_zh: 伦敦出现一尊归于班克斯名下的新雕像：西装男子被旗帜蒙眼、走向边缘
items.summary: Front-page Hacker News discussion (571 points, 550 comments) of a Smithsonian report on a new statue attributed to Banksy in central London, installed at night less than two months after an investigation into his identity.

items.title: xAI Is Reportedly Using Just 11% of Its 550k Nvidia GPUs
items.title_zh: 报道称 xAI 仅用上其 55 万块英伟达 GPU 的 11%
items.summary: Hacker News item (27 points, 17 comments) on a report that xAI is able to use just over 10% of its 550k Nvidia GPUs, with lackluster AI software stack optimization blamed, while Meta and Google squeeze out much more.

items.title: I built my own hair electrolysis machine
items.title_zh: 我自制了一台电解脱毛仪
items.summary: The author describes building a DIY electrolysis machine for permanent hair removal and reviews temporary alternatives such as shaving, epilation and waxing.

items.summary: OpenClaw released version 2026.4.24 on Sunday, bringing both DeepSeek V4 models into the core ecosystem of the open-source agent framework and making them its default, according to TechNode.

items.summary: The Working Mechanism Office for the Security Review of Foreign Investment, which sits under the NDRC, has barred a foreign investment deal related to Manus, according to TechNode.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 report shows multiple R&D staff departures
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 技术报告显示多名研发人员离职
items.summary: The 58-page DeepSeek V4 technical report has drawn attention after its nearly 300-person research and engineering author list showed 10 contributors, amid multiple R&D staff departures.

items.title_zh: 中国处罚未按规定标识 AI 生成内容的平台
items.summary: China's internet regulator has taken action against multiple digital platforms that did not properly label AI-generated content, the latest such enforcement step.

items.title: Show HN: Browser-based light pollution simulator using real photometric data
items.title_zh: Show HN：基于真实光度数据的浏览器光污染模拟器
items.summary: Show HN demo that loads real photometric LDT data into a Bevy scene running in the browser via WebAssembly, letting streetlight intensity distributions drive live sky-glow grades as uplight percentage changes. 44 points, 20 comments.

items.title: DeepClaude – Claude Code agent loop with DeepSeek V4 Pro
items.title_zh: DeepClaude：用 DeepSeek V4 Pro 驱动 Claude Code 智能体循环
items.summary: Hacker News front-page discussion (678 points, 281 comments) of an open-source project that pairs Claude Code's autonomous agent loop with DeepSeek V4 Pro, OpenRouter or any Anthropic-compatible backend, claiming the same UX at 17x lower cost.

items.title: China bars foreign investment in Manus AI project as scrutiny on AI exports grows

items.summary: China's National Development and Reform Commission announced it has issued a decision under relevant laws and regulations, in a TechNode report on barring foreign investment in the Manus AI project amid growing scrutiny of AI exports.

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark
items.title_zh: Nutlope/hallmark
items.summary: An anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, written in CSS.

items.title_zh: b-nnett/codex-plusplus：Codex 桌面应用增强系统
items.summary: Codex++ is a tweak system for the Codex desktop app, written in JavaScript.

items.summary: A Simplified Chinese localization of Matt Pocock's skills, with every update manually reviewed, regular upstream syncing, and support for Claude, Codex and DSH plugins.

items.title_zh: cybercode：融合 Claude Code 与 Hermes Agent 自进化能力的智能体
items.summary: cybercode is a TypeScript AI agent that combines Claude Code's coding capabilities with Hermes Agent's self-evolution features.

items.title: vercel-labs/deepsec
items.title_zh: vercel-labs/deepsec：由编码智能体驱动的代码安全检测工具
items.summary: Deepsec is a security harness that uses coding agents to find vulnerabilities in a codebase; it is written in TypeScript.

items.title: Rimagination/scansci-pdf
items.title_zh: Rimagination/scansci-pdf（Python 仓库）
items.summary: Python repository by Rimagination that is trending on GitHub with 1,155 stars and 103 forks; the GitHub listing provides no further description of what the project does.

items.title: youssofal/MTPLX
items.title_zh: youssofal/MTPLX：在 Mac 上运行 Qwen 3.8 与 Ternary Bonsai 的推理方案
items.summary: Python project pitched as the fastest way to run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next, Qwen 3.8 27B and Ternary Bonsai 2 27B on a Mac, using native MTP speculative decoding on Apple Silicon and claiming 125 tok/s on an M5 Max. 2,635 stars.

items.title: tolimarchuk/goalbuddy
items.title_zh: goalbuddy：给 Codex 和 Claude Code 一个更好的 /goal
items.summary: GitHub Trending repo (826 stars, 66 forks) that offers a better /goal command for Codex and Claude Code, written in JavaScript. The repository is one of several agent-workflow tools trending on GitHub today.

items.title: stemdeckapp/stemdeck
items.title_zh: Stemdeck：面向音乐人的音轨分离平台
items.summary: GitHub Trending project (4,276 stars, 383 forks) called Stemdeck, a stem-extraction platform for musicians, producers and hobbyists that isolates vocals, drums, bass, piano and guitar for practice, transcription, remixing and creative audio work.

items.title: Feasible-First Exploration for Constrained ML Deployment Optimization in Crash-Prone Hierarchical Search Spaces
items.title_zh: 面向崩溃频发层次搜索空间中受限 ML 部署优化的可行优先探索
items.summary: The paper proposes Thermal Budget Annealing, a feasible-first exploration stage that maps valid regions before warm-starting TPE, with trial timeouts and subspace blacklisting for hostile hardware, plus the DeployBench suite; on five GPU targets including the H100, A100 and RTX 5080 it reduced wasted budget relative to cold-start TPE.

items.title: Heterogeneous Scientific Foundation Model Collaboration
items.title_zh: 异构科学基础模型协同
items.summary: Researchers at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign introduce Eywa, a heterogeneous agentic framework that pairs language-based reasoning with domain-specific scientific foundation models instead of forcing every problem through a language interface. It drew 174 Hugging Face upvotes.

items.title: World2Minecraft: Occupancy-Driven Simulated Scenes Construction
items.title_zh: World2Minecraft：基于占据预测的仿真场景构建
items.summary: World2Minecraft converts real-world scenes into structured Minecraft environments using 3D semantic occupancy prediction, and introduces the MinecraftOcc dataset to strengthen occupancy benchmarks for embodied AI tasks such as vision-language navigation.

items.title: Synthetic Computers at Scale for Long-Horizon Productivity Simulation
items.title_zh: Synthetic Computers at Scale：面向长程生产力模拟的规模化合成电脑环境
items.summary: Microsoft researchers propose Synthetic Computers at Scale, a method for creating user-like computer environments with realistic folder hierarchies and content-rich documents, spreadsheets and presentations, then running long-horizon productivity simulations inside them. It drew 20 Hugging Face upvotes.

items.title: Analyzing LLM Reasoning to Uncover Mental Health Stigma
items.title_zh: 分析 LLM 推理过程以揭示心理健康污名
items.summary: The authors analyse LLMs' intermediate reasoning steps, using clinical expertise to categorise and rate stigmatising language about psychological conditions, and find this exposes substantially more stigma than traditional multiple-choice evaluation.

items.title: From Agent Failure Paths to Quantified Residual Risk: A Compositional Framework for Resilient Agentic AI
items.title_zh: 从智能体失败路径到量化残余风险：面向韧性智能体 AI 的组合框架
items.summary: The paper proposes CPSAINT, a seven-layer integrity decomposition covering physical state, sensors, data, compute, actuators, environment and time, paired with FRIESA-K, a residual-risk functional that maps each agent failure path to a quantified risk; it is demonstrated on a warehouse robot and a financial-services agent.

items.title: SafeTune: Mitigating Data Poisoning in LLM Fine-Tuning for RTL Code Generation
items.title_zh: SafeTune：缓解 RTL 代码生成 LLM 微调中的数据投毒
items.summary: SafeTune is a framework for hardening LLM fine-tuning for RTL code generation against data poisoning, combining a graph neural network that detects anomalous circuitry with a semantic verification module that screens prompts. The components filter poisoned inputs without changing the model architecture.

items.title: REALM: An RGB- and Event-Aligned Latent Manifold for Cross-Modal Perception
items.title_zh: REALM：面向跨模态感知的 RGB 与事件对齐潜在流形
items.summary: REALM learns an RGB- and event-aligned latent manifold by projecting event representations into the pretrained latent space of RGB foundation models, using LoRA to bridge the modality gap. It enables zero-shot use of frozen image-trained decoders such as MASt3R on raw event data and reports state-of-the-art wide-baseline feature matching.

items.title: Visual Generation in the New Era: An Evolution from Atomic Mapping to Agentic World Modeling
items.title_zh: 新时代的视觉生成：从原子级映射到智能体式世界建模的演进
items.summary: LMMs-Lab surveys visual generation and argues the field must move beyond appearance synthesis toward structurally, dynamically and causally grounded generation, organized as a five-level taxonomy running from atomic mapping to agentic world modeling. It drew 89 Hugging Face upvotes.
